title: Nine tools overwrite the player's real save when they run
tier_reason: redirecting three path variables in nine scripts that already have the pattern to copy
ask:
`GameState.save_path`, `replay_path` and `trace_path` default to `user://autosave.json`, `user://session_replay.json` and `user://session_trace.jsonl`. Any script that boots `main.tscn` without setting them first writes the real player's files. Nine do: tools/capture_looks.gd, tools/capture_overnight_crow.gd, tools/capture_overnight_plates.gd, tools/capture_t39.gd, tools/capture_watering_inset.gd, tools/record_story_sounds.gd, tools/replay_view.gd, tools/test_visuals.gd, tools/tile_preview.gd.

The later capture tools already do it right and are the pattern to copy: tools/capture_coop.gd, tools/capture_machines.gd, tools/capture_workbench.gd, tools/capture_interior_plate.gd and tools/capture_window_view.gd each set the three paths to a `user://<tool>_scratch*` triple immediately after instantiating main and before any frame runs.

Evidence that this is not theoretical: on 2026-09-15 the desktop's save directory held an autosave, a replay and a trace whose recorded gen_seeds were 2693534206, 425626444 and 245878810 — three different sessions' files sharing one directory, with the replay failing to reproduce the autosave. A rescued copy is in playtests/ under that date's NOTE.md.

Coordinate with the three-slot save work landing in the same area: once slots exist, the right destination for a dev tool is the development slot rather than a per-tool scratch path, and a tool that wants a throwaway world should say so explicitly.
first_action: Read tools/capture_coop.gd's opening as the pattern, then repeat it in the nine scripts listed above.
why: A developer running a capture tool destroys whatever farm is on the machine, silently and with no way back. Daniel's standing rule is that a routine developer action must never break something — and this one eats a player's save, which is worse than a red suite.
outcome: Closed by the save-slot change (S-14). Every rig that boots the game now plays a farm of its own: eight took GameState.use_slot(1, "user://capture_slots_scratch/"), tools/record_story_sounds.gd sets the title screen's own slots_root, and tools/tile_preview.gd — the one the slot work missed — was given the same redirect while the change was being verified. tools/replay_view.gd was on the original list by mistake: it names main.tscn only in comments and already fingerprints live GameState to prove it leaves it alone.
